digest.component_or_area: inbound probe and backend capability routing
propositions: inbound_probe.py currently contains Jira-specific REST code (URL construction, basic-auth GET, status-name classification) that violates core backend neutrality
a second vendor backend cannot reuse the probe because Jira mechanics are hardcoded in the core module with no seam or capability interface
the probe invocation in run_differs.py:369 bypasses the backend object and directly calls module-level probe logic, preventing adapter-level probe override
the neutral probe vocabulary (ProbeBranch, ProbeResult, ProbeConfigError) must remain in core at the package-root location per ADR 0035, separate from vendor probe mechanics
moving Jira probe mechanics to adapters/jira/probe.py and routing through a new SupportsAbsenceProbe capability will restore backend neutrality and allow second vendors to implement probes
